name: Student Management
description: A university's students, courses, attendance and academic records.
hints: Branch values are stored exactly as 'AI', 'Computer Science', 'Electronics', 'Mechanical', 'Civil' (check with get_distinct_values if unsure). Attendance status is present/absent/late. Students' emails and phone numbers are not accessible.

courses.description: Courses offered; branch 'General' means open to all branches.

enrollments.description: Which student is enrolled in which course.

attendance.description: One row per student, course and class date.

academic_records.description: Marks and grades per student, course and term.

examples: Show students in the AI branch.
Who are the top 5 students by CGPA?
What is the average marks per course?
